title: Sad Trombone
blurb: The sad trombone — four descending notes ending in a defeated wah-wah, comedy's oldest fail sound and still undefeated. It predates the internet by decades, having been a vaudeville and radio staple long before anyone put it on a soundboard, which is why it reads as failure to absolutely everyone regardless of age. Play it after a bad joke, a failed attempt, or any anticlimax that needs formally acknowledging. This is an original synthesised rendition of the classic womp-womp cadence, free to download and deploy at funerals for someone's dignity.
origin: Original synthesis of the classic descending 'wah wah wah waaah' fail cadence.
